Daily Devotional

April 30

11 For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, 12 Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world; (Titus 2:11-12 KJV)

The Grace of God has appeared to everyone, teaching us right from wrong (Romans 1:18-20). Even unbelievers have the knowledge of right and wrong, so it is important that the Christian live a righteous life as a testimony of our faith (1 Peter 1:15). If Grace alone saved people then everyone would be saved as all have seen the Grace of God, but it takes Faith in the Grace of God to be saved, so it takes both Faith and Grace for salvation (Ephesians 2:8).

Grace is the unearned, unmerited favor of God to us, and Faith is what we do to accept and appropriate the Grace that God gives us. Therefore God gives by Grace, and our part is to accept by Faith. It takes both, and some teach that you are saved only by Faith, and some teach you are saved entirely by Grace, but it take a combination of the two to be saved (Ephesians 2:8). Thank you Jesus for bringing us the Grace of God, and giving us your Faith (Galatians 5:22-23), to be able to receive it and be saved. Hallelujah!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
